summary: A fixed-size server billed by the hour with a one-hour minimum and a 672-hour monthly cap; a stopped server bills at the running rate until it is destroyed.

egress.included: 0.5–15 TB a month depending on the plan
egress.note: Egress beyond the plan allowance is $0.01/GB worldwide. Inbound traffic is free. Not priced by the calculator.

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.note: No plan and no fee: each server bills hourly from deployment until destroyed, capped at its monthly price.

notes: Prices are Vultr's USD list. The FAQ says some locations can differ and the console shows the local price; the card uses the standard list.

Vultr's billing FAQ derives the hourly rate as monthly ÷ 672. The pricing page rounds some hourly figures (the $20 plan shows $0.03) and lists larger plans at roughly monthly ÷ 730 (the $160 plan shows $0.219); the API publishes a third figure for some plans ($0.027 for the $20 plan). The card uses monthly ÷ 672 so the 672-hour cap equals the monthly price. See research/vultr/research.md, contradiction 1.
The $2.50 1 vCPU / 0.5 GB plan is IPv6-only and is excluded. Its $3.50 twin includes IPv4 and is the smallest shape on the card.
One public IPv4 is included on paid plans; up to two additional addresses are available for an extra fee whose amount Vultr does not publish on the pages read.

Snapshots are $0.05/GB-month, automatic backups add 20%, Block Storage is $0.10/GB-month, Vultr File System is $100/TB-month and Object Storage starts at $18/TB-month. None of these is in the calculator.
Windows licences are extra: $16–$384 a month depending on the plan.
A stopped instance bills at the running rate until destroyed; there is no pause, sleep or cheaper stopped-storage rate.
Vultr labels memory in GB; the plan API returns MB (4096 MB for the 4 GB plan), so the card maps GB to GiB 1:1. Vultr labels disk in GB; the card maps it 1:1 to GiB too.
The card prices the shared Cloud Compute plans (Regular Performance and High Performance). Optimized Cloud Compute, VX1, Cloud GPU and Bare Metal are separate families and are not priced here.

Vultr's public plans API (api.vultr.com/v2/plans, read 2026-10-30) shows prices vary by location: the 2 vCPU / 4 GB plan (vc2-2c-4gb) is monthly_cost 20 by default but location_cost.sao monthly_cost 30 in São Paulo. The card uses the default price.
